summary: Adds a clean get_inlines() hook that get_inline_instances() now calls, exactly matching the issue request and Django's established get_*() override pattern. Backward compatible since default returns self.inlines, preserving existing behavior.

issues.description: No docstring on get_inlines() and admin docs/release notes not shown in diff; maintainers typically pair such hooks with docs, but this is non-blocking for the source change.
